prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, logo-brand.
Refine this exact compact runner app logo so that the runner itself looks constructed from an electrocardiogram trace.
Preserve the mature adult athlete's recognizable running pose and proportions, the small tilted oval outline head, the delicate consistent stroke thickness, and the cyan #20D8F8 to blue #2F7EF6 left-to-right gradient.
Change the line language from soft flowing curves to FIRM GRAPHIC POLYLINES. Use a small number of long clean STRAIGHT segments, subtly inclined where appropriate. Replace the sinuous curves in the back, torso, hips, thighs and calves with controlled straight sections and a few precise corners. Anatomical bends at elbow and knee have clear vertices with only a tiny softening radius. The rear arm has two purposeful straight sections. The front arm is a clear two-section bent arm connected naturally to the shoulder. Keep the adult forward lean, shoulder/hip rhythm and long natural running stride. The figure should feel like the ECG line has become an athlete, rather than a smooth human drawing with a graph attached.
Few precise corners, long straight segments, no excessive zigzags and no spiky faceted anatomy. Not a toy figure or a generic stick person. Keep the small head oval, without enlarging it or making a polygon head. Preserve the carefully drawn anatomical running proportions.
Restore a SHORT ECG context before the runner as well as after it: one small simple up-down pulse and a short horizontal baseline adjoining the back foot at the left, then the runner, then one small simple up-down pulse and short baseline adjoining the front foot at the right. Both baselines align. Keep the two pulses small and subordinate, about half the head height. No long tails and no extra P/T wave bumps.
The whole symbol remains compact and nearly square, around 1.25:1, centered with comfortable margins on a square transparent canvas for an app icon. The runner is dominant, roughly 70% of canvas height. Both ECG segments are brief, not a wide horizontal strip.
Perfectly consistent delicate monoline throughout, around 18px on a 1024px canvas. No thick wedges, no tapering or width variation. Calm clean endpoints and tight controlled corners.
True transparent RGBA background and transparent internal spaces. Smooth restrained gradient on the strokes only. Flat crisp vector-like artwork. No glow, shadow, texture, 3D, background tile, border, words, letters, numbers, labels or watermark. Exactly one final logo symbol.
